jobs.description: What Makes Cloudbeds Unique At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started. How You'll Make an Impact: As Manager, Training & Enablement, you will lead the team that empowers Cloudbeds colleagues and customers through product and hotel operations training. You will own the knowledge, content and learning programs behind it, and bring our new knowledge engine to life. You will also build the operations hub for Customer Success knowledge: documented processes, a content library and the standards behind them. You will run an AI-assisted operating model with expert human oversight. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the vision for how our teams learn, simplify and speed up how the work gets done, and act as the main liaison between Training & Enablement and our cross-functional partners. You will have the chance to shape functional strategy and scale your impact as the team grows. Our Training & Enablement Team: Our team is where Hospitality Hearts meet AI Smarts. We are a fully remote, multilingual group of trainers, writers, localization specialists and hospitality veterans who turn a fast-moving product into knowledge people can use. jobs.description: From Fivetran ’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. We’re looking for an experienced Lead Technical Instructor to enable our customers on the combined Fivetran + dbt product suite. jobs.title: Music Community Ambassador | First Chair Programme
jobs.description: Help shape the future of music teaching in London Are you part of London’s music community and passionate about teaching? Join First Chair , Matchspace Music’s founding ambassador programme, and help bring Europe’s leading platform for music educators to musicians across London. We’re selecting six musicians to help launch Matchspace Music in the UK. You’ll connect with fellow musicians across the city, share what you’re hearing on the ground, and help us understand what independent music teachers need to build and grow their teaching practice. You won’t be handed a script to promote. You’ll help shape how we arrive in London, from the very first week. About Matchspace Music Matchspace Music is Europe’s leading platform for music educators. We help independent music teachers build a professional online presence, get discovered by students, manage their lesson offers and get paid, all in one place. Founded in Switzerland in 2020, we are home to more than 2,000 qualified teachers across over 100 instruments, with more than 2,100 international teachers registered ahead of our launch. We’re now bringing this to the UK, starting with London. What you’ll do As a First Chair ambassador, you’ll: Introduce Matchspace Music to musicians in your peer networks. Start conversations about teaching and the challenges of building an independent teaching practice. Share feedback from your community with the Matchspace Music team. Contribute your own perspective to help shape our UK launch. Work with the team to develop an approach that feels relevant and authentic to London’s music community. This is a six-month freelance engagement, working remotely for four hours per week , starting immediately. Hours can be planned around your studies or other commitments. What you’ll bring We’d like to hear from musicians who: Are actively connected to London’s music community. Care about music teaching and want to help improve how it works. jobs.title: Freelancer - Group Fitness Instructor (m/w/d)
jobs.description: En tant que membre du groupe international PureGym , qui compte plus de 2 millions de membres, nous faisons partie des trois plus grandes chaînes de fitness en Europe. Nous sommes ainsi idéalement positionnés pour poursuivre et réaliser nos objectifs ambitieux. À l’avenir, nous pourrons ainsi contribuer encore davantage à la forme physique et à la santé de la population suisse. Pour renforcer notre équipe Group Fitness motivée, nous recherchons dès maintenant une personne passionnée par le sport pour le poste de Group Fitness Instructor (h/f/d) en freelance pour notre club de Geneve Cornavin , notamment pour les cours suivants : LesMills BODYPUMP, M.A.X., RIDE, TONE, GRIT, ZUMBA, H.I.I.T., PILATES, BODYATTACK, BODYCOMBAT, YOGAFLOW/POWERYOGA, STEP. Tes missions : Tu animes les cours de Group Fitness et transmets tes connaissances avec beaucoup d’enthousiasme. Tu es présent(e) pour nos membres et les accompagnes avant, pendant et après tes cours. Tu prépares tes cours, maintiens une bonne dynamique de groupe et motives les participant(e)s tout au long de la séance. Tu veilles au respect des règles de propreté et d’hygiène dans la salle de cours. Tu connais nos offres ainsi que notre philosophie et sais les transmettre à nos membres. Idéalement, tu organises toi-même tes remplacements et es également disposé(e) à remplacer d’autres instructeurs si nécessaire. Ce que tu apportes : Tu travailles déjà en tant que freelance dans le domaine du Group Fitness et peux justifier de ton statut d’indépendant(e). Tu disposes déjà d’une solide expérience en tant que Group Fitness Instructor pour les types de cours mentionnés et peux présenter des diplômes de Group Fitness ou des diplômes reconnus dans les domaines du yoga et du Pilates. Tu as le talent de motiver les autres et de les aider à progresser à chaque entraînement. Tu enthousiasmes nos membres grâce à la diversité de tes entraînements et sais accompagner aussi bien les débutant(e)s que les participant(e)s avancé(e)s vers

jobs.description: About DataCamp DataCamp's mission is to empower everyone with the data and AI skills essential for 21st-century success. By providing practical, engaging learning experiences, DataCamp equips learners and organizations of all sizes to harness the power of data and AI. As a trusted partner to over 17 million learners and 6,000+ companies , including 80% of the Fortune 1000, DataCamp is leading the charge in addressing the critical data and AI skills shortage. About the role Research has consistently shown that one-on-one tutoring dramatically outperforms traditional classroom instruction—a finding known as Bloom's 2 Sigma Problem. Despite decades of awareness, no solution has successfully delivered personalized tutoring at scale. Until now. We are building an AI tutoring system designed to emulate and eventually surpass the best human tutors. You will work on the core AI system that delivers real-time, adaptive learning experiences to learners. If you're excited about building the future of human learning, this role is for you. This role can be done remotely from anyone of the following; United States, United Kingdom, Belgium, Portugal OR UAE About you At DataCamp, we seek individuals who embody our core values of data-driven decision-making, action, transparency, ownership, and customer focus. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performing environment and are driven by a passion for making a meaningful impact. You're adaptable, embracing change and ambiguity with enthusiasm. Your initiative and entrepreneurial spirit push you beyond just meeting targets—you aim to understand the "why" behind our goals and take ownership to drive the business forward. You're a collaborative team player who values transparency and always seeks to improve and innovate. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!
